title: Lectin C Gene Analysis
author: Tran Vinh Phuong
materials: RevertAid First Strand cDNA Synthesis kit

steps.title: Purify Total RNA
steps.instruction: Purify total RNA from mammalian tissue using the GeneJET RNA Purification Kit (Thermo Scientific, USA).

steps.title: Synthesize First Strand cDNA
steps.instruction: Perform first strand cDNA synthesis using the RevertAid First Strand cDNA Synthesis kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA).

steps.title: Purify PCR Products
steps.instruction: Purify PCR products using the GeneJET Gel Extraction kit (Thermo Scientific, USA).

steps.title: Clone into pGEM T-easy Vector
steps.instruction: Clone the purified products into the pGEM T-easy vector (Promega, USA).

steps.title: Isolate Plasmids
steps.instruction: Isolate plasmids using the GeneJET Plasmid Miniprep Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA).

steps.title: Translate Amino Acid Sequence
steps.instruction: Translate the amino acid sequence using Expasy.

steps.title: Predict Protein Domain
steps.instruction: Predict the protein domain using SMART.

steps.title: Predict Protein Structure
steps.instruction: Predict the protein structure using Phyre2.

steps.title: Predict Isoelectric Point
steps.instruction: Predict the isoelectric point using IPC2.
